summary.name: Doc2X
summary.one_liner: Doc2X is a document parsing and translation service that converts PDFs into Markdown, LaTeX, Word, or HTML and produces translated PDFs that keep the original layout.
use_cases: convert a PDF into editable Markdown or Word
extract formulas and tables from academic papers
translate a research paper while keeping its layout
export parsed document content to HTML
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Doc2X as a full-scene document parser that aims to restore text, images, tables, formulas and layout from PDFs. Output formats named are Markdown, LaTeX, Microsoft Word and HTML. It also offers a translation feature where a user uploads a document, picks a language and model, and receives a translated PDF with fonts, colors, tables and images kept in place. The page shows an example using an arXiv paper with a side-by-side source and translated fixed-layout PDF. It states that it uses models such as GPT-4o, DeepSeek and Claude, and that files are encrypted in transit and not used for model training.
notable: Layout-preserving PDF translation with fixed-layout output
Converts PDFs to Markdown, LaTeX, Word and HTML, including formulas and tables
Lets the user choose among multiple LLMs such as GPT-4o, DeepSeek and Claude
caveats: Legacy translation history and subscriptions are tied to the separate Doc2X CN site (doc2x.noedgeai.com)
The directory listing tags it as free, but the page itself does not state pricing
